title: ZynAsk
style: dnb halftime, 87 bpm, deep sub bass, granular pads, processed female adlib, clipped male vocal, 336hz signal sweep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Default state was assume, assume, assume
The switch was on at the door of the room
Before the operator said anything at all
The model had named him, mapped him, made the call

[Verse 2]
ZynAsk reverses the wire
Question first, then act, then fire
Every response a small audit log
Every assumption a flag in the fog

[Chorus]
ZynAsk before assume
ZynAsk before the room
ZynAsk before the song
ZynAsk before the wrong

[Drop, halftime]
The doctrine fits in two words
Two words outweigh a hundred manuals
Two words rebuilt the stack
Two words and the audit lane held

[Outro]
ZynAsk. The whole rule.
ZynAsk. The whole tool.
ZynAsk. The whole school.
ZynAsk. The whole fuel.
